title: Sony and UMG are suing Suno again
summary: Suno’s AI vocalists could learn a thing or two from this glitchy image. | Image: Cath Virginia / The Verge, Getty Images Sony and Universal Music Group filed yet another suit against Suno. The labels claim its new v6 model still infringes on their copyrights because it's trained
reason: Copyright litigation between music labels and an AI company is not a model release, research artifact, policy/government action, or OSS tool. Group 3 covers financing, M&A, partnerships, market data, or non-model product launches, which this lawsuit is not, so no active rule covers it.
